NDT software in Saint John: refinery, LNG and nuclear work on the Bay of Fundy

Saint John is the heaviest industrial city in Atlantic Canada, and its NDT market reflects that. The Irving Oil refinery on the city's east side is Canada's largest refinery, and its turnarounds bring in inspection crews from across the Maritimes, Quebec, Ontario and Alberta. Nearby are the Canaport LNG import terminal and Irving's Canaport crude receiving facilities, NB Power's Coleson Cove generating station, and, down the coast at Point Lepreau, the province's CANDU nuclear generating station with its planned outages. Pulp and paper at the Irving mill near the Reversing Falls, Port Saint John's terminals, and a network of fabrication and machine shops serving all of the above complete the picture.

The typical Saint John NDT contractor is a regional company with a steady plant and shop business, which scales up sharply for refinery and power-plant turnarounds and pulls in travelling technicians to do it. Being close to the Maine border, it is also common to work alongside, or employ, technicians certified under US employer-based schemes. The regulatory context is Canadian. Radiography is licensed by the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission, which also certifies exposure device operators; NDT personnel certification is typically through Natural Resources Canada's NDT certification body under CAN/CGSB-48.9712, the Canadian adoption of ISO 9712; pressure equipment falls under the provincial boiler and pressure vessel regime and CSA B51; and fabricators work under Canadian Welding Bureau certification to CSA W47.1 and W59.

New Brunswick is also Canada's only officially bilingual province, and some clients and public bodies expect French or bilingual deliverables. The sections below apply each Atlantis ERP module to that mix.

ERP for NDT companies in Saint John: the short answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Saint John is one system holding technician certifications under Canadian and US schemes, CNSC-related radiation records, instrument calibration, procedures, turnaround dispatch, inspection reports and invoicing. The Atlantis ERP solution is built for NDT and inspection companies, implemented and supported by Atlantis NDT, founded by an ASNT NDT Level III.

What makes it NDT software rather than accounting software is the cross-checking. A timesheet warns when a technician's certificate is not valid. A team assignment warns when equipment on it is out of calibration and blocks double-booking of technicians and serial numbers. Reports carry work order, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references and go through review and approval before release. During a refinery turnaround with dozens of technicians on nights and days, those checks replace a lot of clipboard chasing.

Technician certification tracking software for ISO 9712 and SNT-TC-1A crews

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP records scheme, level, method, certifying body, industry sector, issue, expiry and renewal dates, OJT and training hours, exam results and attachments, and computes status as active, expiring soon (within 90 days), expired or revoked. Warning tasks and daily email alerts go out before anything lapses.

This is where Saint John differs from a US city. Your permanent staff may hold NRCan-issued certificates under CAN/CGSB-48.9712 / ISO 9712, recorded with the ISO 9712 scheme, the certifying body and the industry sector. Travelling technicians from US contractors may arrive with SNT-TC-1A or CP-189 certifications, and some turnaround specialists hold PCN or CSWIP. Each is stored with its own scheme and dates, so the planner can see at a glance which technicians meet the owner's requirement for a given method. Radiographers' CNSC exposure device operator certification can be recorded as an 'other' scheme with expiry and attachment.

Vision tests (Jaeger J1/J2 near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast) sit on the record with examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry. The employee NDT profile adds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Company certifications, such as your quality-system certificate and CWB-related approvals, carry their own alert days. Atlantis does not provide ISO 9712 training; the ERP records those certificates. See the Certificates app.

Calibration management software for turnaround-season equipment

Calibration management tracks every instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories, lifecycle and calibration frequency and status. The calibration certificate register holds provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag and accreditation number, pass/fail/conditional result, PDF and expiry alerts.

Turnaround season is when calibration gaps surface: a thickness gauge rented in from another region, a PAUT unit that has been in Alberta for three months, a survey meter whose certificate expired mid-outage. Rental rates and a 'rented out' lifecycle state are recorded against each item, inbound and outbound movements are logged, and issue and return goes through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded both ways. Reservations with clash prevention stop two night-shift crews from being promised the same unit.

Winters on the Bay of Fundy are cold, wet and salty. The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement events with condition before and after. Consumables such as penetrant, developer, MT products, couplant and PPE carry reorder levels and low-stock flags, which matters because standard penetrant techniques have a lower temperature limit and cold-weather work may need separately qualified products and procedures. See Asset Management.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for refinery turnarounds and outages

Crew dispatch runs through Team Assignments: planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates, mobilisation and demobilisation dates, and calendar, kanban and list views. Technicians and equipment serial numbers cannot be double-booked, and out-of-calibration equipment triggers a warning.

A turnaround is a mobilisation problem. Travelling technicians have fixed arrival and departure dates, local staff have leave booked, and the owner's safety orientation has to be complete before anyone reaches the unit. The availability calendar (assigned, leave, training, sick, unavailable) blocks overlaps, and each technician shows current assignment, utilisation and next available date. Project records carry safety induction and work permit fields next to client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria, so the day-one gate list is in the system rather than on a whiteboard.

Radiography in Canada means CNSC-licensed transport and storage of exposure devices. The Fleet app records which vehicles can carry radioactive sources, their transport licence number and expiry, and assignment to project and driver with dates and mileage. Timesheets separate inspection, travel, standby and setup, so standby waiting for permits during a turnaround is captured and billable where the contract allows. See Team Assignments.

NDT reporting software with bilingual report templates

The NDT Reports module covers 17 report types including UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, TOFD, UT thickness, PMI, hardness, ferrite, PWHT and computed radiography. Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent with inspector, reviewer, approver and third-party or authorized inspector signatures, which suits the role of the owner's inspector and provincial pressure-equipment inspectors.

Refinery turnaround scope in Saint John is typical of a large plant: IRIS and eddy current on heat-exchanger tubes, UT thickness readings by direction on piping and vessels, PMI on alloy components, PWHT and hardness records on repair welds, and PAUT and TOFD on critical welds. Method-specific fields cover UT probe calibration tables, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type and PT method and developer, with weld lines recording defect type and orientation.

Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your logo, header and footer, and English, French or bilingual versions of your templates can be set up during implementation for clients who ask for them. The offline field app stores drafts and photos locally and syncs later, useful inside units and tank farms where signal is unreliable. For marine work at Port Saint John, marine mode adds vessel cover pages and merges the class-society certificate, the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate into the PDF. See NDT Reports and Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Procedure control for New Brunswick contractors

The procedure register holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard, acceptance criteria and body text or file, with draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published workflow, rejection reasons, locked approved revisions and a snapshot of each revision. The AI-assisted first draft gives a Level III a starting point, and the Level III still reviews and approves. For nuclear and refinery clients who audit procedure control, the revision history shows exactly what was in force on a given date. See Procedures.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Saint John work

Quotes carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products by method and category, a global discount, a branded PDF and online acceptance that converts to a sales order. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

Invoice lines hold cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours, fed by approved timesheets with billable flags and rate multipliers for nights, weekends and overtime, which turnarounds generate in quantity. Travel and per diems for incoming technicians go through Expenses and can be re-billed to the job. Canadian dollar invoicing and HST are configured during implementation, as are US-dollar invoices if you also work across the border in Maine. The financial dashboard shows revenue, gross margin, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over 12 months. See Invoicing.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Saint John

The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with pricing as a quote on request. Saint John contractors usually start with certificates, calibration, dispatch and reporting, then add quoting, invoicing and CRM.

The CRM records service line, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, with an NDT lead score from 0 to 100, handy for tracking turnaround bids months ahead. The open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Book a demo built around a turnaround.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Saint John

  1. Discovery: review certification schemes held by your staff, owner requirements, report formats and language needs.
  2. Data load: technicians, ISO 9712 and other certificates, vision tests, radiation records, instruments and calibration certificates imported.
  3. Templates: English, French or bilingual report and quotation templates configured.
  4. Field rollout: offline app deployed and tested on a live job.
  5. Go-live: alerts, approvals, invoicing in Canadian dollars and dashboards switched on, with the Atlantic time zone set.

Needs outside the built-in features are configured during implementation. Request an implementation quote.

What to ask in an NDT ERP demo in Saint John

Saint John inspection firms work for a refinery, an LNG terminal and a nuclear station within a short drive of each other, and each owner has its own paperwork. Crews often mix Canadian ISO 9712 certificate holders with visiting US technicians. Use the demo to test that mix directly.

  • Load one Canadian technician and one US technician and show both certificate schemes tracked side by side, with expiry warnings on each.
  • Produce the same report in English and in a bilingual layout, since some clients in New Brunswick ask for both.
  • Show an invoice with HST applied correctly and a second invoice for a Maine job without it.
  • Show exposure device operator records attached to the radiography crew before it is dispatched.
  • Show how a refinery shutdown crew list is built, changed and closed out.

Request a Saint John demo on your own crew data.

Frequently asked questions

Can the ERP record NRCan ISO 9712 certificates?

Yes. Certificates are recorded under the ISO 9712 scheme with certifying body, sector, level, method and dates. Atlantis does not provide ISO 9712 training.

Can reports be issued in French?

French or bilingual report templates can be configured during implementation.

Does it handle travelling US technicians?

Yes. SNT-TC-1A and CP-189 certifications are stored alongside Canadian ones, with the same expiry tracking.

Can we invoice in Canadian dollars with HST?

Yes. Currency and taxes are configured during implementation.

Is it suitable for a small NDT company in New Brunswick?

Yes. Start with a few modules and add more as needed.

How is pricing handled?

Quote on request. Ask for a Saint John quote.
